newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Clariant sales rose nine percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Clariant sales rose nine percent in 1996.

text.p: Swiss chemicals company Clariant AG said on Thursday that group sales rose by 192 million Swiss francs ($135.1 million) in 1996 to 2.34 billion francs.
"This corresponds to a considerable increase of nine percent in Swiss franc terms, and seven percent in local currencies," Clariant said in a statement.
It said that favourable sales developments in the third quarter continued in the final quarter of 1996 and earnings would rise at least 10 percent.
"The concern profit will, in line with expectations, show a double-digit increase in comparison to the previous year," it said. ($1=1.4205 Swiss Franc)
